verses.gurmukhi: ੧੯ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਤੇ ਕਾਦਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 19 : kudharat te kaadhar bea(n)t asagaeh hai

en.bdb: The creator and His creation are infinite

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: kudharat agam athaahu a(n)t na paieeaai|

en.bdb: Creation, the power of the Lord is unrpproachable and unfathomable.
Nobody can know its extent. That creator is without any anxiety;how could He be persuaded and amused.
How the majesty of His court could be described.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਸੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: koi na dhasai raahu kit bidh jaieeaai|

en.bdb: None is there to tell the way and means leading to Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd sifat salaeh kiau kar dhiaaieeaai|

en.bdb: This is also incomprehensible that how infinite are his eulogies and how should He be concentrated upon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: abigat gat asagaahu na alakh lakhaieeaai ||19||

en.bdb: The dynamics of the Lord is unmanifest, deep and unfathomable; it cannot be known.
